##### Project general facts

Golf Apartments by Al Hamra is a distinguished residential development located in Al Hamra Village, offering a harmonious blend of modern living and natural beauty. Set within one of the most established communities in Ras Al Khaimah, the project features a selection of studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments designed to provide both comfort and scenic tranquility in a well-connected setting.

Positioned with panoramic views over the Al Hamra Golf Course and Al Hamra Bay, the residences offer a unique living experience surrounded by lush greenery and serene waterfront landscapes. The development reflects a lifestyle centered around relaxation and outdoor living, with access to landscaped areas, walking areas, and recreational facilities that enhance the overall sense of tranquility and community.

The apartments are built to high specifications with quality finishes and fittings throughout, ensuring a refined and comfortable environment. Each unit includes an equipped kitchen for everyday convenience, while the residences are offered unfurnished, allowing homeowners to personalize their interiors according to their individual style and preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Hamra Village is a well-established waterfront community in Ras Al Khaimah, known for its relaxed coastal lifestyle and scenic surroundings. Set along pristine beaches and a championship golf course, the area offers a harmonious blend of natural beauty and modern living, making it a popular choice for both residents and investors.

The community features a wide range of residential options, from apartments to villas, many with views of the Arabian Gulf, lagoons, or lush fairways. It is home to key attractions such as Al Hamra Golf Club, Al Hamra Marina & Yacht Club, and a selection of hotels, restaurants, and cafés, creating a vibrant yet tranquil atmosphere.

Al Hamra Village also benefits from strong infrastructure and convenient connectivity, with easy access to Ras Al Khaimah city center and major highways. With its resort-style environment, walkable layout, and growing lifestyle offerings, it continues to evolve as one of the emirate’s most desirable residential destinations.
